title: Cover remaining narrow-observation fence and dirty-marker branches
outcome: Deterministic observation controls isolate background fence-send failure, expected-image mismatch and unchanged background dirty markers, without polling, retries or weaker durability assertions.
acceptance: A control queues persistence successfully, then causes the observation fence send to fail, and asserts factual Failed visibility, narrow publication and no durable acknowledgement.
A control isolates the expected-image comparison independently of execution-id waiter replacement and rejects obsolete acknowledgement.
A BackgroundQueued control asserts that the three dirty markers are not cleared; existing synchronous-success cleanup and publication controls remain passing.
